# leader-election

> Lease-based leader election for Go services over Postgres or Redis: exact SQL and Lua, monotonically increasing terms, step-down before the lease expires and an in-memory store Go module `github.com/Trysac/u242-leader-election`, package `leaderelection`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
